title: Cloud Security: commitment exit
content:
Cloud Security uses the following tier-specific bases for commitment exit.

## Basis

Commitment forgiveness on termination: Whether customer termination forgives an unexpired signed commitment; boolean.

## Tier values

| Security tier | Commitment forgiveness on termination |
|---|---|
| Northbridge Cloud Security 50 Workloads | No |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 100 Workloads | No |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 250 Workloads | No |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 500 Workloads | No |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 1000 Workloads | No |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 2500 Workloads | No |

## Tier comparison

The listed commitment exit bases are the same across these six Security tiers.
